setup.linksDescription: The direct link connects this page straight to the Pi: 10 updates/s, and it keeps working when the cloud is down. Video comes from MediaMTX on the Pi.
setup.directHint: An https page can only open wss://. Tailscale (tailscale serve) gives a valid certificate; ws:// works when this app runs on http://localhost.
setup.detail_mixedContent: an https page cannot open ws:// — use wss://
setup.detail_unreachable: check the Pi is up, the URL and port, and allow local-network access if the browser asks
setup.how1: Generate a token on the right and save the config on the Pi as /etc/vehicle-companion/<name>.toml (including [direct]).
setup.how2: On the Pi run tailscale serve --bg --https=443 http://127.0.0.1:8765 and enter the resulting wss:// URL above.
setup.how3: Restart vehicle-companion@<name>; the status changes to “connected”.

check.operatorSysid: The companion sends an “operator” heartbeat as sysid {sysid}, but MAV_GCS_SYSID (SYSID_MYGCS before 4.7) is {current}, so the GCS failsafe will not recognise it.
check.operatorNoFs: FS_GCS_ENABLE is 0: the operator heartbeat triggers nothing.
check.alwaysMasks: The companion sends heartbeats always and MAV_GCS_SYSID (SYSID_MYGCS before 4.7) matches it: losing the operator will not trigger the GCS failsafe.
check.noBattery: BATT_MONITOR is 0: no battery monitoring, so battery failsafes cannot act.
check.battNoAction: A low voltage is set but BATT_FS_LOW_ACT is 0 (no action).
check.armingOff: ARMING_CHECK is 0: pre-arm checks are disabled.
check.storm32Mavlink: STorM32 over MAVLink (MNT1_TYPE=4): set every SRx_* stream rate on the gimbal's serial port to 0 or it floods the gimbal.
check.storm32Serial: MNT1_TYPE=5 is the legacy STorM32 serial driver; olliw recommends 4 (MAVLink).
check.telem2NotMavlink2: SERIAL2_PROTOCOL is {value}: if the Pi is on TELEM2 it should be 2 (MAVLink2).

params.compareHint: Mission Planner's Compare Params: compare with a .param file or another snapshot, see only what differs, tick what to stage for writing.

logs.tlogDescription: The companion records every MAVLink packet on the Pi, one file per arming. Mission Planner and MAVExplorer open them.
logs.needDirect: Downloading tlogs needs the direct link. Set its URL in the Setup tab.
logs.listFailed: Could not list files: check the direct link is connected.
logs.disabled: tlog recording is off in the companion (tlog_dir is empty).
logs.analyseDescription: Use ArduPilot's own web tools: UAV Log Viewer for plots; WebTools for filter, PID and compass reviews. Drop the file in.
logs.dfDescription: Copies .bin logs from the autopilot's SD card to the companion over MAVLink, then from the Pi to your browser. Disarmed only; the autopilot pauses logging during the transfer.
logs.dfArmed: The vehicle is armed: ArduPilot only serves logs while disarmed.
logs.dfNeedControl: Take control above to list or copy logs.
logs.dfHint: Speed depends on the autopilot-to-Pi link: hundreds of kB/s over USB or 921600 baud, about 5 kB/s over a telemetry radio (an hour for 20 MB). For very large logs, pull the SD card.

gimbal.streamHint: Direct link: angles stream while dragging (the companion caps them at 10 per second so a STorM32 does not lag), then one confirmed command on release.
gimbal.cloudHint: Over the cloud only the release is sent. Use the direct link for continuous control.
gimbal.tips: Right-click the map and choose “Point camera here” to keep the camera on a spot; with video as the main view, click the picture to aim.

payload.pulseTitle: On for {ms} ms, then off (e.g. a dropper or shutter)
payload.hint: Commands go straight to the payload node (MAVLink component 25 by default); switch states are what the node reports. The autopilot forwards them only if that TELEM port runs MAVLink (SERIALx_PROTOCOL=2).

follow.title: Follow me
follow.idle: Uses this device's location (a phone's GPS is best) to keep the vehicle with you; the target updates when you move 3 m or every 5 s.
follow.block_poorFix: Location not accurate enough (needs {acc} m or better).
follow.block_noVehiclePos: The vehicle's position is not known yet.
follow.block_tooFar: The vehicle is more than {max} m from you; bring it closer first.
follow.stoppedFix: No location for 5 s: stopped following. The vehicle holds its last target.
follow.confirmDescription: The vehicle switches to GUIDED, moves to {distance} m at {bearing}° from you and keeps following. Leaving this tab, losing your location or the link stops it (the vehicle holds its last target). Mind obstacles.

replay.description: Tracks kept in the cloud for 7 days (a point every 2 s while armed). For detail use the tlog or DataFlash log.
replay.loadFailed: Could not load the track history.
replay.none: No flights in this period (armed for over 20 s counts as a flight).
replay.pick: Pick a flight on the left.

camera.countHint: Photos are stored on the Pi with EXIF GPS of where the vehicle was when each was taken; purple dots on the map mark them.
camera.needDirect: Viewing photos needs the direct link.
camera.hint: ✈ = triggered by the autopilot (e.g. a survey's DO_SET_CAM_TRIGG_DIST with CAM1_TYPE = 6).

signing.title: MAVLink2 signing
signing.description: With signing on, the autopilot only accepts MAVLink carrying the right signature, so nobody can pose as your ground station over the radio or network.
signing.configHint: Add [signing] passphrase = "a passphrase of 12+ characters" to the companion config and restart it.
signing.noteMp: Mission Planner needs the same passphrase to connect (it uses the passphrase's SHA-256 as the key, like the companion).
signing.notePorts: A STorM32 or ESP32 on another autopilot port is refused unless that port's MAVn_OPTIONS bit 0 (accept unsigned) is set and the autopilot rebooted.
signing.noteUsb: USB always accepts unsigned messages, so a mistake can be undone from Mission Planner over USB. The key survives reboots.
signing.confirmEnable: The companion writes its key into the autopilot. Ground stations without the key (including Mission Planner until you set the passphrase there) and peripherals on other autopilot ports are refused until configured. Continue?
signing.confirmDisable: Sends a zero key; the autopilot accepts unsigned MAVLink again.
signing.enabledToast: Signing key written to the autopilot

cloud.loadFailed: Could not load the cloud files
cloud.none_photo: No photos uploaded yet. Set [upload] enabled = true in the companion config and turn the camera on.
cloud.none_dataflash: No DataFlash logs uploaded yet. Logs downloaded from the autopilot are uploaded automatically.
cloud.none_tlog: No telemetry logs uploaded yet. Each flight's log is uploaded after disarming.
